mechanism: Cenobamate is metabolized by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4; ceftazidime has minimal hepatic metabolism but both drugs may affect CNS function, and cenobamate has a narrow therapeutic index with seizure threshold considerations.
action: Monitor seizure control and cenobamate levels; ceftazidime is generally safe but ensure adequate renal function monitoring as both may have renal clearance implications in certain patient populations.
